title: Why remote work is dying and nobody wants to admit it

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if the future of work isn’t remote, but something we haven’t even imagined yet?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Hybrid models now use AR for collaboration, but lag in real-time 3D design and immersive project management.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Remote work erodes community bonds and widens inequality — not everyone has access to the tools or environment needed.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are developing lightweight, low-latency 5G/6G networks and edge computing to bridge the gap in remote collaboration.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where work is fluid, with AI-assisted co-creation tools that bring people together regardless of location.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn’t remote or office — it’s a dynamic, inclusive ecosystem shaped by technology and human needs.
